name: Leaving a Dungeon Finder group while dead revives the player outside the dungeon
contract: Issue #5099: a player who dies in a Dungeon Finder dungeon and leaves the group before releasing is teleported out by LFGGroupScript::OnRemoveMember through Player::TeleportToEntryPoint. Moving an unreleased body out of an instance leaves the player dead at the entry point, where releasing creates the corpse. Like leaving a battleground, leaving the group revives the player (at 50% health, as re-entering an instance to a corpse does) before the teleport, so the player arrives alive at the entry point on map 0.

steps.label: The seeker is dead and unreleased
Leaving teleports the seeker to the entry point
The seeker is revived at half health
